data.description: Experience Sustainable Luxury in Dubai's Green Oasis: DAMAC Hills 2

data.answer:
Located adjacent to DAMAC Hills in Dubailand, residences in DAMAC Hills 2 offer a more secluded, tranquil, and eco-friendly environment. Situated between Jebel Ali – Lehbab Road (E77) and Al Ain – Dubai Highway (E66), DAMAC Hills 2 is designed to encourage harmony with the natural world, from sophisticated villas to townhouses with eco-friendly features.

Whether they are relaxing in the peaceful atmosphere of their own home, strolling through the community parks, or engaging in outdoor activities amidst the expansive open spaces, inhabitants lead an exceptional lifestyle. With its cutting-edge features, leisure areas, water features, and energetic community spirit, DAMAC Hills 2 is the perfect example of contemporary luxury living infused with the allure of in nature.

Properties in DAMAC Hills 2 community are modern sanctuaries that provide residents with luxury and sustainable living. The residential clusters are surrounded by green landscapes, with many properties also consisting of private gardens. Apart from the villas and townhouses, a few serviced hotel apartments offer breathtaking golf course views. Some of the famous clusters in DAMAC Hills 2 are Vardon, Camellia, Albizia and Amargo.

Most Popular Location in Damac Hills 2

Here are some notable locations within DAMAC Hills 2:

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Dubai DAMAC Hills 2?

data.answer:
Life in DAMAC Hills 2 offers a harmonious blend of luxury living and natural serenity. Residents of this vibrant community enjoy an unparalleled lifestyle surrounded by lush green landscapes and open spaces, fostering a sense of tranquility and well-being. From upscale villas to modern apartments, each home is thoughtfully designed to enhance comfort and convenience.

With world-class DAMAC Hills 2 amenities, including a championship golf course, parks, fitness centers, and retail destinations, residents have ample opportunities for leisure and recreation. The community's eco-friendly initiatives promote sustainability and green living, creating a sustainable environment for families to thrive. Overall, DAMAC Hills 2 offers a unique living experience where residents can escape the hustle and bustle of the city and embrace a relaxed yet luxurious lifestyle amidst nature's beauty.

Public Transportation in DAMAC Hills 2 Dubai

With the majority of the road infrastructure now completed within the community, navigating the area has become notably convenient. However, there is currently no bus or metro service available within or close to the area. Should one require RTA bus services, they can be accessed from the bus stations in the neighboring community of Mira.

Residents with private transportation can fully utilize the well-connected road network. There are four major highways accessible to residents to reach key areas across the emirate. Jebel Ali – Lehbab Road (E77) to the south offers connectivity to Al Ain – Dubai Road (E66) in under a 20-minute drive. Additionally, Al Qudra Road (D63) borders Damac Hills 2 to the west, and by utilizing Bypass Road at the southeastern gates, access to Al Maktoum International Airport is facilitated. Al Qudra Road also links with Emirates Road (E611), providing easy access to central areas such as Motor City and Al Barsha.

Supermarkets in DAMAC Hills 2 Address

One of the popular supermarkets in DAMAC Hills 2 is Carrefour Supermarket, located on the ground floor of the Damac hills 2 Community Center. CHoitram and Spinneys are also situated inside the neighborhood.

Residents of DAMAC Hills 2 and nearby communities can buy daily grocery items, fashion wear, mobile phones and more.  Also, 247 Grand Supermarket delivers a selection of grocery items in the community. You can find everything from fruits and vegetables to electronic products in this superstore.

Shopping in DAMAC Hills 2

There is a community center in DAMAC Hills 2 with various retail and dining options. The two-level Damac hills 2 Community Center is located in the heart of the northern neighborhood. Besides, residents can easily access shopping centers in the neighboring communities, a short drive from DAMAC Hills 2.

For a comprehensive shopping experience that combines groceries, fitness facilities, and gaming options, The Ranches Souk in Arabian Ranches is worth a visit. Dubai Outlet Mall can be reached within a 20-minute drive via Al Ain Road. It offers a blend of culture and entertainment and boasts an art gallery, a food court, and various fun activities.

Moreover, the mall houses numerous brand stores, including popular names like Mango and Tommy Hilfiger. Another prominent shopping destination, Cityland Mall, is 25 minutes away in Wadi Al Safa. Renowned for its unique features, like a central park and amphitheater, it stands out as one of Dubai's premier shopping centers. 

Schools Near DAMAC Hills 2

Currently, there are no schools in DAMAC Hills 2, but you can find excellent nurseries there, including Shining Stars Early Childhood Centre and Cherry Tree Nursery. Both follow the British Early Years Foundation Stage (EYFS) curriculum, offering a range of educational and engaging activities. Shining Stars Early Childhood Centre caters to children aged 1.5 to 4 years and is situated in Virdis Towers within the area. On the other hand, Cherry Tree Nursery is conveniently located inside the Damac hills 2 Retail Centre.

Jebel Ali School is around a 12-minute drive from the neighborhood and is a fantastic option for residents of DAMAC Hills 2. It is located on Remraad Desert Road, Mudon and follows the EYFS and National Curriculum of England. The Fairgreen International School is 17 minutes away from the area. The school in The Sustainable City was established in 2018 by Esol Education and follows the IB curriculum.

Universities in DAMAC Hills 2

DAMAC Hills 2 is conveniently located near several reputable universities and educational institutions in Dubai. Nearby options include the American University in Dubai (AUD), Dubai International Academic City (DIAC) which hosts multiple universities such as Heriot-Watt University, and Mohammed Bin Rashid University of Medicine and Health Sciences (MBRU). 

Churches, Temples and Mosques in DAMAC Hills 2 Area 

Situated approximately 20 to 22 minutes away by car from DAMAC Hills, It’s a development by DAMAC Properties. While it enjoys a secluded setting without immediate neighbors, it is in close proximity to Emaar's expansive master development, Reem, where sub-communities like Mira and Mira Oasis have been established.

Traveling towards Mira Oasis via Bypass Road would take approximately 22 minutes by car. Furthermore, although Damac hills 2 is located away from the city center, it boasts excellent connectivity to key destinations such as the Mall of the Emirates and Al Maktoum International Airport via four major highways. Additionally, prominent business and leisure districts like Internet City, Media City, Studio City, and Barsha Heights (Tecom) are conveniently accessible from the area.

Clinics and Hospitals in DAMAC Hills 2

The DAMAC Hills 2 community is currently served by a Saudi German Clinics branch, with plans underway for additional specialty clinics and general hospitals in the area. Presently, residents can access healthcare services at Mediclinic Parkview Hospital, located on Umm Suqeim Road, just a 22-minute drive away. Additionally, Aster Clinic, another healthcare facility, is conveniently located in the vicinity of Arabian Ranches, reachable within 16 minutes of the community.

DAMAC Hills Location & Nearby Areas

DAMAC Hills is strategically located in the heart of Dubailand, offering residents a prime position within one of Dubai's most dynamic and sought-after neighborhoods. Situated just off Umm Suqeim Road, this expansive development enjoys easy access to major highways, including Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Qudra Road, facilitating convenient travel to key destinations across the city. Surrounded by established communities such as Arabian Ranches, Motor City, and Dubai Sports City, residents of DAMAC Hills benefit from proximity to a wide range of amenities and attractions. 

Additionally, the community is located near renowned educational institutions, healthcare facilities, shopping malls, and leisure destinations, ensuring that residents have everything they need right at their doorstep. With its central location and vibrant surroundings, DAMAC Hills offers residents a modern and luxurious lifestyle in one of Dubai's most coveted residential districts.

more_info.question: Things to Do in DAMAC Hills 2 Dubai

data.answer:
DAMAC Hills 2 offers an array of activities and amenities for residents and visitors to enjoy. Golf enthusiasts can tee off at the championship golf course, while families can spend quality time at the parks, playgrounds, and picnic areas scattered throughout the community. Fitness enthusiasts can make use of the state-of-the-art gyms and fitness centers, while those seeking relaxation can unwind at the spa or take leisurely walks along the scenic trails. The community also hosts various events and social gatherings, providing opportunities for neighbors to connect and build relationships. With retail outlets, restaurants, and cafes within easy reach, there's always something to do and explore in DAMAC Hills 2.

Restaurants in DAMAC Hills 2 Dubai

The master plan encompasses numerous local eateries and upscale dining establishments. Presently, residents of DAMAC Hills 2 have access to a variety of restaurants located within the community  Retail Centre and neighboring communities such as Mudon, Arabian Ranches, and Dubai Outlet Mall. Notable dining venues include Al Tawon Restaurant, Taqado Mexican Chicken, Tuk Tuk Thai, Chuck E Cheese, and Abatjour Bistro. Additionally, dining options are available at the Trump Golf Course, offering three distinct ambiance settings. Among these are PRATO, serving Italian cuisine, and 71 Sports Bar, which features pool tables and live sports broadcasts alongside a selection of international comfort food options for guests to enjoy.

Beaches Near DAMAC Hills 2 Location

Beaches are a little away from the community. The nearest options include Sufouh Beach and Jumeirah Beach, which are around 30 minutes' drive away from DAMAC Hills 2. Nonetheless, numerous water features are currently being developed in the vicinity. Damac hills 2 Dubai is set to introduce a captivating Water Town, offering a serene and refreshing ambiance. Anticipated attractions include Malibu Beach, lazy river, paddle boarding, and wave surfing opportunities. Moreover, the children's water park within the area will feature a Splash Pad, water slides, and a water playground for endless fun. Additional amenities include a lakefront cafe and a unique floating cinema experience.

Hotels in the DAMAC Hills 2 Dubai Area

In the Damac hills 2 area, you'll find a selection of hotels catering to various preferences and budgets. One notable option is the Radisson Hotel Dubai DAMAC Hills, offering modern accommodations and amenities for business and leisure travelers alike. Additionally, the Park Inn by Radisson Dubai Motor City provides convenient access to Damac hills 2 and surrounding areas, with comfortable rooms and facilities. For those seeking a more luxurious stay, the DAMAC Maison Royale The Distinction is a five-star hotel located nearby, offering upscale accommodations and personalized service. These hotels provide convenient options for visitors to Damac hills 2 area, ensuring a comfortable and enjoyable stay during their time in Dubai.

Attractions and Landmarks in DAMAC Hills 2

DAMAC Hills 2 offers many attractions and landmarks to suit every taste and interest. Golf enthusiasts can indulge in the world-class experience at the Trump International Golf Club Dubai, designed by renowned architects and offering breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape. For those seeking relaxation and recreation, the community features beautifully landscaped parks, serene walking trails, and scenic picnic spots perfect for enjoying quality time outdoors. The community's vibrant shopping and dining destination, Vista Lux, provides an array of retail outlets, restaurants, and entertainment options for residents and visitors to explore. Additionally, the community hosts various events and social gatherings, fostering a sense of community and belonging among its residents.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

In DAMAC Hills 2 Dubai, residents have access to various outdoor activities, fitness facilities, and beauty services to enhance their lifestyle. The community boasts lush green spaces and scenic walking trails, perfect for outdoor workouts, jogging, or strolls amidst nature. Fitness enthusiasts can use well-equipped gyms and fitness centers within the community, offering a range of classes and equipment for cardio, strength training, and yoga. Additionally, residents can indulge in beauty and wellness treatments at nearby spas, salons, and skincare clinics, providing rejuvenating experiences and personalized services. Whether staying active outdoors, hitting the gym, or pampering oneself with beauty treatments, DAMAC Hills 2 offers a comprehensive array of options to promote health, fitness, and well-being for its residents.

DAMAC Hills 2 is located on the outskirts of Dubai, which means residents may experience longer commute times to reach central areas of the city. Moreover, as a developing community, residents may experience ongoing construction activities, contributing to noise pollution and dust in the area. While these disruptions may diminish as the community matures, they can temporarily inconvenience residents.

Who owns DAMAC Hills 2?

DAMAC Hills 2 is owned by DAMAC Properties, one of the leading luxury real estate developers in the Middle East.

What are the cluster names in DAMAC Hills 2?

The cluster names in DAMAC Hills 2 include:

  • Vardon Cluster
  • Claret Cluster
  • Silver Springs Cluster
  • Janusia Cluster
  • Aster Cluster
  • Pelham Cluster

What is the difference between Damac Hills 1 and 2?

The main difference between DAMAC Hills 1 and DAMAC Hills 2 lies in their development stages and features. DAMAC Hills 1, also known as DAMAC Hills Akoya 2, is a more established community with a wider range of amenities, including the Trump International Golf Club Dubai, luxury villas, townhouses, and apartments, along with retail and dining options. DAMAC Hills 2, on the other hand, is a newer development phase within the same master community, offering additional residential options and amenities that are still under development.

How many units are in DAMAC Hills 2 Al Qudra?

The number of units in DAMAC Hills 2 varies depending on the specific cluster and type of property. DAMAC Hills 2 includes a mix of villas, townhouses, and apartments across different clusters, with each cluster containing a different number of units.

Where is DAMAC Hills 2 (Akoya Oxygen) located? 

DAMAC Hills 2, also known as Akoya Oxygen, is located in Dubailand, Dubai, UAE.

Is DAMAC Hills 2 chiller free? 

Yes, DAMAC Hills 2 offers chiller-free properties, meaning cooling costs are typically included in the service charges.

Can I purchase off-plan properties in DAMAC Hills 2? 

Yes, off-plan properties are available for purchase in DAMAC Hills 2, offering opportunities to invest in upcoming developments within the community.

nodes.title: Park Greens 2
nodes.about:
Park Greens 2 is the second phase of a luxury project from developer Damac. Located in Damac Hills 2, the development is a premium collection of 5-bedroom villas. Each residence sits on its own private plot, which also provides space for a swimming pool, Jacuzzi or outdoor movie theater. All homes have floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows and private balconies or terraces.

Within walking distance of the development is a green, scenic park totaling 51 million square feet. Park Greens 2 offers residents exclusive amenities including Malibu Beach, multi-sports courts, a pet farm and a paintball park.

Damac Hills 2 is a thriving neighborhood filled with life. It is connected to four major highways and other networks that allow easy access to the city. The major community of Damac Hills is just 15 minutes away by car, Al Maktoum International Airport, Dubai International Airport and Mall of the Emirates are within a 30-35 minute radius, while Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina are approximately 40 minutes away.

Park Greens 2 is one of the most attractive residential developments. This picturesque complex offers its residents the perfect combination of comfort, luxury and modern design. Its convenient location, close to shopping, restaurants, parks and entertainment centers, makes Park Greens 2 an ideal place to live for both families and singles who appreciate comfort, beauty and security.

nodes.title: Navitas Hotel & Residences
nodes.about:
Navitas Hotel & Residences is a mixed-use development that is part of the Akoya Oxygen (Damac Hills 2) community. The development was developed by leading property developer DAMAC Properties.

The complex consists of 5 buildings with a height of 15 floors, united by a common podium with commercial spaces. One of the towers houses a hotel, the other four are private residences. The residential complex offers exclusive studios and 1-bedroom apartments.

All residences have modern interior with designer finishes, furniture, spacious living room, equipped kitchen, "Smart Home" system, air conditioning and heating, panoramic glazing, large balcony. There are views of the golf course and the sights of the neighbourhood.

For the comfort of residents, the complex has 24-hour security and video surveillance, gym and swimming pool, underground parking, high-speed lifts, sauna and bath, SPA centre, reception and lobby, public park, outdoor playground. Residents of the complex can use the services of a maid, concierge, service desk. On the private landscaped territory there are walking and cycling paths, areas for recreation and walks, restaurants, cafes and shops. A large golf course is located in front of the complex within 2 minutes walk.

Close proximity to Al Qudra Road with an exit to Sheikh Zayed Road allows for quick access to other parts of the city. Dubai International Airport is a 36-minute drive away.
